paper_title: PromptMind Team at EHRSQL-2024 Improving Reliability of SQL Generation   using Ensemble LLMs
caption: Individual vs Ensemble Models
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between cost and reliability score for three different models. The y-axis, labeled "Reliability Score", has a linear scale with a range of 30 to 90 and tick labels at intervals of 20, starting from 30 and ending at 90. The x-axis, labeled "Cost", has a linear scale with a range of 0 to 10 and tick labels at intervals of 2, starting from 0 and ending at 10. The plot contains three lines: a blue line representing the 3-Model Ensemble, a red line representing the 2-Model Ensemble, and a yellow line representing GPT-4. The blue line starts at approximately 84 and ends at approximately 74. The red line starts at approximately 86 and ends at approximately 72. The yellow line starts at approximately 90 and ends at approximately 38.
